note: Real screenshots of the local demonstration stack on this machine, taken on 26 November 2026 (Indian time) by presentation/src/capture_screens.mjs in headless Chrome: a 1440 x 900 window at 1.5x, light theme, reduced motion, the browser's clock set to Asia/Kolkata. The offline keyword rules read the customers' messages, except in images 10, 10b, where the "openai" provider read them (each image says so in read_by). All data is synthetic and the client, SkyLink Telecom, is fictional; the "enterprise systems" are the team's simulator. Nothing in any image is mocked, edited or composited; a "crop" is a part of the real page. The stack ran with a technician visit offered after 20 seconds (the product default is 10 minutes), the network looked at again every 10 seconds, and credits up to $500 applied without review (above $500 a supervisor approves). visible_facts were read from the page at the moment of capture; "pixels" is the size of the image. File numbers 01 to 12 follow the twelve shots the deck asked for, a letter marks a companion image of the same scene, and 13 and 14 are extras.
known_blemish: On customer-desk images whose network chip reads "outage confirmed · HH:MM IST", the values in the complaint-reference box run a few pixels past its right border. That is how the page lays out in a 1440 px window; it was not retouched, and each such image says so in its notes. 02w is the happy-path reply in a 1600 px window, where the box has room.
